# Brave
> Privacy-focused browser, search, AI, and web services designed to block trackers and put users first.

Brave offers a privacy-first browser for desktop and mobile, independent search, AI features, VPN and firewall tools, and developer APIs. Its ecosystem spans consumer products, premium services, support resources, and search API documentation.

## Browser Downloads
- [Brave Browser](https://brave.com/): Main product overview for Brave’s private, secure, and fast web browser.
- [Download Brave for Desktop](https://brave.com/download/): Download Brave for Windows, macOS, and Linux desktop systems.
- [Brave for Android](https://brave.com/android/): Android browser download page with mobile privacy and browsing features.
- [Brave for iOS](https://brave.com/ios/): iPhone and iPad browser download page with privacy-focused mobile browsing.
- [Brave vs. Other Browsers](https://brave.com/compare/): Comparison pages contrasting Brave with other browsers and search engines.

## Browser Features
- [Shields Ad Blocker](https://brave.com/shields/): Built-in blocking for ads, trackers, fingerprinting, and other privacy threats.
- [Privacy Features](https://brave.com/privacy-features/): Overview of Brave browser privacy protections and security capabilities.
- [More Features](https://brave.com/features/): Broader feature overview including performance, privacy, and usability enhancements.
- [Brave Leo](https://brave.com/leo/): Browser-integrated AI assistant focused on privacy-preserving interactions.
- [AI Features](https://brave.com/ai/): Overview of Brave’s AI capabilities across browser and search products.

## Search
- [Brave Search](https://search.brave.com/): Independent search engine with privacy-preserving web, image, and news search.
- [Search Features](https://brave.com/search/): Product overview for Brave Search capabilities and privacy-focused search experience.
- [Ask Brave](https://search.brave.com/ask): AI-powered answer experience within Brave Search.
- [Brave vs. Other Search Engines](https://brave.com/compare/): Comparison content covering Brave Search against competing search providers.
- [Web Discovery Project](https://support.brave.app/hc/en-us/articles/4409406835469-What-is-the-Web-Discovery-Project-): Support article explaining Brave’s privacy-preserving search data contribution system.

## Search API
- [Search API Overview](https://brave.com/search/api/): Overview of Brave Search API features, access, and product positioning.
- [Developer Documentation](https://api-dashboard.search.brave.com/app/documentation/web-search/get-started): Getting started documentation for integrating Brave’s web search API.
- [API Use Cases](https://brave.com/search/api/use-cases/): Example applications and scenarios for Brave Search API integration.
- [How-to Guides](https://brave.com/search/api/guides/): Practical implementation guides for common Brave Search API workflows.

## Premium and Privacy Services
- [Brave Firewall + VPN](https://brave.com/firewall-vpn/): Subscription privacy service combining VPN protection and firewall capabilities.
- [Premium Services](https://brave.com/premium/): Overview of Brave’s paid offerings and subscription-based privacy products.
- [Privacy Features](https://brave.com/privacy-features/): Summary of privacy protections available across Brave products.
- [Brave Shields](https://brave.com/shields/): Core browser privacy layer for blocking ads and invasive tracking.

## AI
- [Brave Leo](https://brave.com/leo/): Private AI assistant built into the Brave browser experience.
- [AI Features](https://brave.com/ai/): Central overview of Brave’s AI-related product capabilities.
- [Ask Brave](https://search.brave.com/ask): Search-integrated AI answers for questions and exploratory queries.
- [Brave Search](https://search.brave.com/): Search platform that complements Brave’s AI and answer experiences.

## Support and Help
- [Brave Support](https://support.brave.app/): Official help center for Brave browser, search, and related products.
- [Web Discovery Project Help](https://support.brave.app/hc/en-us/articles/4409406835469-What-is-the-Web-Discovery-Project-): Detailed explanation of the Web Discovery Project and participation model.
- [Brave Community](https://community.brave.com/): Community forum for troubleshooting, discussion, and product feedback.
- [Brave Creators Support](https://support.brave.com/): Support portal for Brave Creators and related ecosystem tools.
